title: Sindh Civil Servants Second Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Civil Servants Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS
SINDH CIVIL
SERVANTS
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I 8th December, 2001]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(38)/2001,
dated 8‑12‑2001.‑‑‑The following Ordinance
made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Sindh Civil Servants (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Civil Servants Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 13(i) of Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973

SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS
SINDH CIVIL
SERVANTS
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I 8th December, 2001]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(38)/2001,
dated 8‑12‑2001.‑‑‑The following Ordinance
made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑
2. Amendment of section 13(i)
of Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973.‑ In the Sindh Civil Servants Act,
1973 (Sindh Act XIV of 1973), in section 13, in clause (i), for the words
"twenty‑five", the word "twenty" shall be
substituted.
